answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because island only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, comet is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
